Camila / team —

Thanks for the summary. Quick legal assessment:

- Data residency: we can accept a clause that requires us to process customer data in the US region unless they specify an EU APAC requirement (that would trigger a Private deployment conversation). Suggest wording: "Redwood will process Customer Data in data centers in the United States unless otherwise agreed in writing."
- Retention: acceptable to offer 90 days for standard logs and 365 days for audit logs; will add an optional schedule in the DPA for longer retention with associated pricing.
- Subprocessors: we'll provide our current subprocessors list and a 30-day notice for changes.
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys via our cloud partner (we will include the KMS provider name and a short config note).

I produced a clean redline summary and a draft DPA with the suggested language. Legal can turnaround a formal redline within 48 business hours once Crescent sends initial redline (or we can push our standard DPA via DocuSign if they prefer).

Attaching: DPA_redline_v2.docx
